cells.name: eye_checker
cells.species: a checkerboard in (log r, θ) that spirals into an off-center eye

cells.name: heart_spiral
cells.species: hearts tiled down an endless log spiral, pulsing on a beat that runs inward

cells.name: bayer_spiral
cells.species: a log spiral quantised to palette steps with an 8x8 Bayer dither on chunky pixels

cells.name: droste_zoom
cells.species: square frames bent by the Escher log map so one turn is one zoom level

cells.name: conformal_hex
cells.species: a hex tiling laid in (log r, θ), so the cells shrink as they spiral into the center

cells.name: twin_threads
cells.species: two counter-wound spiral thread families woven over and under

cells.name: petal_shear
cells.species: florets in the lattice of two counter spirals, shearing as the winding breathes
eq: f = (n/2π)·(θ + σ ln r,  θ − σ ln r) + ω t
one floret per cell of fract(f),  bloom = ½ + ½ sin(3 ln r − 2t)

cells.name: vortex_duo
cells.species: a two-color vortex of ribbon arms around a glowing eye

cells.name: hairline_spiral
cells.species: two spiral families of hairlines that stay one pixel wide at every depth

cells.name: record_groove
cells.species: an Archimedean groove with an anisotropic sheen, spinning under a label

cells.name: dot_drift
cells.species: two dot lattices, one turned by a fraction of a degree, beating into rosettes
eq: two dot lattices: g_A = fract(N·x),  g_B = fract(N·R(α)x)

cells.name: line_grating
cells.species: two bar gratings a few degrees apart, one wavering, as light through both

cells.name: ring_grating
cells.species: two circular gratings on orbiting centers, beating into hyperbolic fringes

cells.name: hex_square
cells.species: a hex dot screen over a square dot screen, dark dots on light

cells.name: radial_fan
cells.species: two radial spoke fans with offset centers, their product mapped through the palette

cells.name: hex_wave
cells.species: three wave sources sampled once per hex, so the light steps cell by cell
eq: v = ½ + Σᵢ sin(k|c − sᵢ| − ωt)/6,  i = 1…3
c = hex cell center,  k = 18…46,  ω = 1.5…5

cells.name: hex_terrain
cells.species: beveled hex tiles raised to the height of drifting noise at their centers
eq: tile height = smoothstep(0.2, 0.8, h),  c = hex cell center

cells.name: hex_rings
cells.species: concentric hex rings pulsing outward, each cell a stroked hex around a growing core
eq: v = ½ + ½ cos(κ·ring − ωt),  ring = hex distance from center
core radius = 0.1 + 0.22v,  stroke at hex distance 0.4

cells.name: hex_truchet
cells.species: hex Truchet tiles of three arcs each, turned at random, with dashes flowing along the tubes

cells.name: hex_led
cells.species: a hex LED panel showing a turning spiral in four brightness steps

cells.name: square_corridor
cells.species: rounded-square outlines receding by 1/r, twisted into a spiral

cells.name: star_corridor
cells.species: two star corridors interleaved, counter-rotating as they rush past

cells.name: chevron_rings
cells.species: chevron bands marching out of a tunnel in 1/r depth

cells.name: hyper_throat
cells.species: a wireframe throat with rings at geometric spacing flowing into a glowing neck

cells.name: brick_tunnel
cells.species: a brick-lined tunnel in (θ, 1/r) with a light at the far end

cells.name: glyph_rings
cells.species: rings of tiny bitmap glyphs, each ring turning against its neighbours

cells.name: glyph_rain
cells.species: columns of falling glyphs with bright heads and fading trails

cells.name: glyph_spiral
cells.species: glyph cells laid on a log-polar lattice, spiralling into the center

cells.name: glyph_tunnel
cells.species: glyphs on the walls of a 1/r tunnel, flying out past the viewer

cells.name: glyph_shade
cells.species: a lit sphere drawn in glyphs, each cell picking a glyph by its ink weight

cells.name: seigaiha
cells.species: overlapping wave crescents of concentric arcs, a slow shimmer across the rows
eq: scales: circles of radius 1 on rows jΔy, Δy = 0.5, x offset (j mod 2)
arcs: ⌊n·d⌋ mod 2,  n = 3…6,  d = distance to the scale center
shimmer = ½ + ½ sin(0.8cₓ + 1.7c_y − ωt),  ω = 0.5…3

cells.name: phyllotaxis
cells.species: a golden-angle seed head, a pulse running outward through the seeds
eq: seed n at r = c√n,  θ = n·137.508°  (Vogel)

cells.name: gear_train
cells.species: four spur gears at true pitch-circle tangency, turning by tooth ratio
eq: centers at R_A + R_B and so on (pitch circles touch)

cells.name: guilloche
cells.species: rose-engine guilloche: phase-shifted lobed curves interlaced in two bands
eq: r = 0.36 + A sin(n(θ + φᵢ) + ψ),  φᵢ = 2πi/(nM)

cells.name: rosette
cells.species: a folded rose window: four petal layers turning at their own rates
eq: S folds:  θ′ = |((θ − ωₗt) mod 2π/S) − π/S|
petal l = ellipse at rₗ = 0.1 + 0.105l,  l = 0…3

cells.name: star_lattice
cells.species: an eight-point star lattice on a diagonal grid, the stars breathing in a wave
eq: ω = 0.5…2,  cell = round(x·(3…7)),  alternate cells turn ±
